verdict.rationale: Docs show scraping returns HTML/Markdown/screenshots and support pre-scrape browser actions (click, wait, scroll), which implies a headless-browser rendering pipeline capable of handling JS-driven pages, but no evidence explicitly states SPA/JS-heavy rendering support or fully-rendered DOM capture guarantees. missing for 10: explicit claim of JavaScript execution/headless browser engine, confirmation of handling dynamic SPA content, and independent verification of SPA rendering accuracy.
